players.product: NIPSCO GenCo generation and electric service built under IURC-approved special contracts and PPAs for Amazon and Alphabet data centers in Indiana

quarterly_data.signal: 10-K: NiSource states that its partnership with ADS (Amazon Data Services) exposes it to significant customer concentration risk; although it anticipates expanding its base of data center customers, it expects the total number of data center customers it serves to remain relatively small, and any future data center contracts may contain termination and/or capacity reduction provisions and related reimbursement comparable to the ADS Contract.

10-K: NIPSCO Electric 2025 revenue was $2,208.9 million versus $1,913.6 million in 2024; electric sales were 16,538.8 GWh versus 16,062.5 GWh (industrial 8,344.8 GWh), which the company attributes primarily to residential customer growth and increased commercial usage, partially offset by lower industrial usage; steel-related industries were approximately 49.3% of industrial MWh sales.
